claims.text: On Tuesday in Corpus Christi, President Trump said of a tanker: "See that little ship out there? It's got one million barrels of oil on it from Venezuela." The shipment follows a U.S. oil deal with Venezuela after the ouster of Nicolás Maduro, and Trump said Texas refineries will process the oil.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio joined Trump in Texas to welcome the tanker, said he intends to see Venezuela transition to democracy before he leaves office, and said: "You're not going to street-protest your way into a democracy."
Rubio said Venezuela first needs a new Supreme Court and election council to replace a system designed to allow rigged votes (WORLD's summary of his remarks).
Opposition leader María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela after months abroad to cheering crowds and called for new elections.

claims.text: At a Lubbock, Texas rally on Oct. 27, 2026, Trump said: "I would pick Ted Cruz to be the next Supreme Court justice." Fox reported he joked Cruz could win unanimous confirmation and that he had no vacancy or nomination to announce.

shorts.hook: White House: Melania Brokered A Ceasefire
shorts.narration: [serious] The White House announced Friday that First Lady Melania Trump brokered a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the city of Oleshky. claims.text: The White House announced on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, that First Lady Melania Trump brokered a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in Oleshky, meant to allow humanitarian aid and civilian evacuations.
The White House says Trump started the talks and worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to set the terms.
Oleshky residents lack electricity, heat and running water, and food and medical supplies have been scarce for months, per AP.
Melania Trump hosted a U.N. Security Council meeting on children in conflict earlier this year and personally wrote to Vladimir Putin about reuniting displaced children with their families, per AP.
